tldr: Meta had no dedicated AI coding-agent product until Aug 5, 2026, when it introduced Muse Code alongside an updated Muse Spark 1.2, framed explicitly as competition for Claude Code and Codex. CNBC's launch report and three other outlets covered the same framing through Aug 9, with no pricing, availability, or benchmark details disclosed for either product.
whats_new: Meta shipped a second Muse product on Aug 10 — Muse Glimmer, a local, open-source, multimodal agentic model — five days after Muse Code's still-undisclosed-pricing coding-agent launch.
why_it_matters: Muse Glimmer is Meta's first open-weight, local-inference entry in this line — worth evaluating for on-device or self-hosted agent workloads, separate from Muse Code's still-opaque cloud coding-agent terms.

status.detail: Meta now ships Muse Code (cloud coding agent, undisclosed pricing) and Muse Glimmer (local open-source agentic model, shipped Aug 10) as separate lines.

beats.headline: Meta debuts Muse Code and Muse Spark 1.2, pitched against Claude Code and Codex
beats.summary: Persistent async background agents is the headline capability; the product is framed explicitly as a Claude Code/Codex rival from day one.

beats.headline: Comparison coverage continues four days later, no new specifics
beats.summary: Aug 9 pickup restates the same launch and comparison framing without pricing, availability, or benchmark updates.

beats.headline: Meta ships a second, separate Muse product: Glimmer, a local open-source agentic model
beats.summary: Announced via Meta's Hugging Face blog, Glimmer is pitched as local, agentic, multimodal, and open source — a different bet than Muse Code's closed cloud service.

open_questions: Has Meta announced pricing or general availability for Muse Code and Muse Spark 1.2?
Do independent benchmarks show how Muse Code's async background agents compare to Claude Code and Codex on real coding tasks?
Is Muse Code available to external developers, or is it limited to Meta's internal/enterprise use?
Under what license is Muse Glimmer released, and are model weights actually downloadable?
Is Muse Glimmer built on the same base model as Muse Code, or a separate architecture aimed at on-device use?
take_for_builders: Don't switch coding-agent workflows yet, but pull Muse Glimmer's weights and license terms now if you need a local or self-hosted multimodal agent — that's shipping today, unlike Muse Code's still-undisclosed pricing and availability.
